title: Maintenance & Entity in Charge of Maintenance

canonicalTerminology.definition: The entity in charge of maintenance is the entity responsible for the maintenance of a vehicle and is registered as such in the vehicle register under the applicable EU railway framework.

claims.text: A maintenance system links maintenance development, fleet maintenance management, maintenance delivery and management functions so vehicles can be maintained in a safe state of running.
claims.applicabilityNote: Educational canonical statement. Apply current ECM legislation, approved maintenance documentation and organisation-specific procedures for operational use.

visualSpecs.purpose: Show ECM maintenance-system functions and information feedback.

prohibitedUnsupportedClaims: Do not invent maintenance intervals, acceptance values or task instructions.
Do not treat training material as an ECM-approved maintenance instruction.
